findings.claim: The stage endpoint's own operator contract never mentions the new mandatory precondition (both downstream flags exactly "true", else 503 PROMPT_REFINER_STAGE_ACTIVATION_FLAGS_REQUIRED): its §2/§4 request description and its §8 503 list still name only runtime identity/source and audit signing key, so an operator reading the writer contract cannot explain a flags-off 503.
findings.reproduction: `rg -n "PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_(RUN_APPROVAL|EXECUTION)_ENABLED|ACTIVATION_FLAGS|activationReady" docs/ops/prompt-refiner-durable-stage-writer-contract.md` returns no matches, while lib/promptRefinerStageAdmission.ts:518-524 refuses with 503 `PROMPT_REFINER_STAGE_ACTIVATION_FLAGS_REQUIRED` before any audit or stage write (asserted by tests/integration/prompt-refiner-reservation-admission.db.test.ts:134-155). Expected: the same contract that lists the writer's refusal codes names this one. The gate is documented only in the new docs/ops/prompt-refiner-confirmatory-shadow-v5.md §2.

findings.claim: The v4 contract still asserts in the present tense that the admin stage preview and create-only writer bind 188 fixed source files ("188개 중 178개 … 나머지 10개는 … 두 migration") and carries no supersession marker, which is now false for the shipped writer and contradicts the new v5 doc.
findings.reproduction: `rg -n "188개 고정 source 파일|두 migration" docs/ops/prompt-refiner-confirmatory-shadow-v4.md` vs `PROMPT_REFINER_RUNTIME_SOURCE_FILE_COUNT = 189` in lib/promptRefinerStageAdmissionCore.ts:41 and the 189-file list at lines 60-71. Nothing fails, because tests/promptRefinerRuntimeSourceClosure.test.mjs:1423,1432 moved the count assertion from the v4 doc to prompt-refiner-confirmatory-shadow-v5.md, leaving the v4 count unguarded. Expected: a one-line 상태/supersession note (v4 계약은 v5 successor로 대체됨) rather than editing the round's approval record.

findings.claim: The pinned success-audit metadata records no flag state, so the durable row plus audit cannot themselves show that both downstream flags were enabled at approval time; the evidence rests entirely on the bound source closure containing the refusal path.
findings.reproduction: Read the `jsonb_build_object(...)` shape in the INSERT branch: keys are admissionVersion … reason, with no runApprovalEnabled/executionEnabled. Compare docs/ops/prompt-refiner-confirmatory-shadow-v5.md §2, which makes the two-flag conjunction the gating fact. Adding the pair would require changing the trigger's exact metadata shape and the writer together, so it is reasonable to defer; recorded only so the omission is deliberate.
